threads.body: `AsyncSemaphore` already exists in Redisson 3.17 (and earlier), so this check does not establish the advertised 3.18 lower bound. That allows this module to be considered for older Redisson releases, where the constructor/field-based advice may be incompatible. Please use a class or structural matcher that was actually introduced in 3.18.

replies.body: `AsyncSemaphore` already exists in Redisson 3.17 and earlier versions, but its package path is `org.redisson.pubsub.AsyncSemaphore` for Redisson 3.17 and earlier releases.
